# ⚠️  DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE
#
# AutoRAG Architect v3.0 uses uv for dependency management.
# All dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml and locked in uv.lock.
#
# To install:     cd backend && uv sync --all-groups
# To add a dep:   uv add <package>
# To add dev dep: uv add --group dev <package>
#
# This file is retained only for IDE compatibility tools that expect it.
# The source of truth is pyproject.toml.
